card.name: Store or shop after a goods word
card.fires_on: Place nouns like stores, shop, factory, wash or sales that complete a compound after a goods or business word, such as pet, aquarium, car, pizza or airplane.

modes.label: Retail outlets
modes.description: The word store or shop follows a product or pet word, naming where something is bought.

modes.label: Factories and businesses
modes.description: Factory, wash or Sales ends a compound naming a workplace or company.
modes.example: Bianchini was a riveter at an airplane<< factory>> during World War II.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word endings of compound place names, though the listed tokens are mixed and unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the second half of phrases like pet store or car wash, where a shop or factory is named.
